title: Stream Sum
statement: Implement `solve(lines)`. Each item is one line of text. Skip lines that are empty after stripping. Interpret every other line as a base-10 integer and return the sum. The lines are already in memory. Do not require a file.
constraints: Blanks and whitespace-only lines are skipped
Every other line is a valid integer
hints: Strip each line. An empty result is a skip, not a zero you parsed.
A running total does not need a second list.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A stream of integers often has blank lines from the way a human wrapped the file.

editorial: A stream of integers often has blank lines from the way a human wrapped the file. Skipping blanks and adding the rest is a single pass. Building a list of the numbers first would work and would hold the data twice.
